source_title: Convention relating to the Status of Stateless Persons
notes: Defines stateless person and creates protection standards for persons not recognized as nationals by any state.

source_title: Convention on the Reduction of Statelessness
notes: Framework for preventing statelessness at birth, in loss of nationality, and in state succession contexts.
Article 15 recognizes the right to a nationality and protection against arbitrary deprivation.

source_title: International Covenant on Civil and Political Rights
notes: Protects legal personality, equality, family life, child registration, and related rights.

source_title: Convention on the Rights of the Child
notes: Article 7 addresses birth registration, name, and nationality for children.

source_title: Convention on the Elimination of All Forms of Discrimination against Women
notes: Article 9 addresses equality in nationality law and transmission of nationality to children.

source_title: International Convention on the Elimination of All Forms of Racial Discrimination
notes: Important for racialized nationality denial and discrimination in citizenship regimes.
UNHCR overview of the 1954 and 1961 statelessness conventions.

source_title: Handbook on Protection of Stateless Persons
notes: Guidance on definition, status determination, and protection for stateless persons.

source_title: Global Action Plan to End Statelessness 2.0
notes: Current UNHCR strategy for reducing and preventing statelessness.
